title: Quantile-aware regression detection for hybrid tensor/pipeline throughput benchmark
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Build a reproducible hybrid tensor+pipeline parallel throughput benchmark and add a quantile-aware regression detector that targets p50/p95/p99 tails for tokens/sec and latency. Scope: (1) workload generator with realistic sequence-length distribution and KV-cache warmup; (2) multi-GPU tensor/pipeline configs (1/2/4/8 GPUs, TP x PP combos); (3) metric collection: tokens/sec, p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization, CUDA kernels/sec, memory spill events; (4) statistical detector that runs on time-series of percentiles and supports CI gating and alerting. Success criteria: benchmark runs end-to-end in CI within 45 minutes for 8-GPU configs, detector flags regressions with <5% false positive rate on synthetic regressions, and dashboards surface broken rollouts within 10 minutes. Implementation plan: extend existing harness to support hybrid sharding modes, add synthetic workload profiles (short/long-tail/mixed), implement percentile extractor, compute EWMA on tail deltas, bootstrap baseline for small-sample significance, and add alerting to #perf-alerts and a CI check. Deliverables: benchmark harness, detector library (py), CI gating job, perf dashboard panel, and onboarding doc.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Ticket created by Ava. Initial scoping and success criteria captured. Noted dependencies on cross-node adaptive batcher work (ENG-13122) and hybrid-parallel harness (ENG-17401).

2026-02-25 - Prototype workload generator checked in to feature/benchmark/quantile-proto. Uses sampled sequence-length distribution from production traces (anonymized) and simulates KV-cache cold/warm transitions. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1824

2026-03-02 - Early 4-GPU runs show tokens/sec stable but p95 spikes on cold cache. Captured waveform in dashboard: https://internal.redwood.com/dashboards/throughput/ENG-21041 (perm: team-redwood). Observed metrics: 4xA100 @ seq512 baseline 4200 tokens/sec, p95 latency 112ms; after synthetic kernel variation p95 jumps to 180ms.

2026-03-05 - Decided to use percentile-Delta EWMA + bootstrap significance test instead of simple mean-shift to reduce false positives from transient noise. Design note: EWMA alpha tuned to 0.2 for p95, bootstrap n=200 replicates for p-value estimation.

2026-03-08 - Integrated detector into CI: perf-gate job runs benchmark on a small reserved 2-GPU cluster; passes baseline checks. CI item: https://ci.redwood.com/job/perf-gate/ENG-21041. Added soft alerts to #perf-staging for initial runs.

2026-03-10 - Stress test: simulated regression by adding 12% extra kernel time on one node; detector fired at p95 with p-value 0.004 and EWMA delta 22%. Created incident playbook and annotated run: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/ENG-21041+-+Stress+run

2026-03-12 - Current blockers: flaky network congestion on cross-node runs causing higher variance; investigating NIC tuning and rerunning with isolated fabric. Next steps: harden sample collection, reduce CI walltime by adaptive sampling, and wire alerts to #perf-alerts with paging for P0 regressions.
